title: Three-tag Praxis without published tag-direction corrections
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5379 MiB (5.2526 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 59230 million field multiplications (14974 and 44257), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
